usage: A 'long6 saam1 gaa3' is a noun that refers to an object used for drying clothes.
You can use 'long6 saam1 gaa3' in sentences as the subject or object, like 'I put the wet clothes on the clothes drying rack.'
'Long6 saam1 gaa3' is a countable noun, so you can say 'a long6 saam1 gaa3' or 'two long6 saam1 gaa3s.'
When giving commands or suggestions, you can say 'Please fold the clothes off the long6 saam1 gaa3.'
'Long6 saam1 gaa3' is mostly used in home or laundry contexts and rarely outside those.
